avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, then if a wall is in front of its left half turn right 20°, else if a wall is in front of its right half turn left 20°; in bright light nothing runs.
driveInTheDark, stopAtWall and followLine are defined but never called from anywhere.
